name: FUN_ALLOC_STEPS
description: This table contains the properties of an allocation process step, including the name, description, type, and other information.

columns.name: STEP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Allocation Process Step.

columns.name: STEP_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of Allocation Process Step.

columns.name: STEP_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the Allocation Process Step.

columns.name: STEP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the Allocation Process Step. Possible values are Allocation, Formula, and Reclass.

columns.name: GROUP_CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Allocation Process Group Context.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.description: Stores additional information required for process execution.

columns.name: POST_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the transaction should be posted automatically.

columns.name: REVIEW_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if allocation process should stop for transaction to be reviewed.

columns.name: NO_TRANSACTION_OUTPUT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if allocation process should stop if no transaction is created for an allocation step.

columns.name: ROUNDING_DIFF_DESTINATION_CODE
columns.description: Rounding the difference destination of balances generated during process execution.

columns.name: ANALYTIC_VIEW_NAME
columns.description: Name of analytic view used to determine the chart of accounts and calendar applicable for the step.

columns.name: CALCULATION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the output from the step is for calculation or for generating transaction lines.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
